cards.subject: a bright Scandinavian bedroom for a child aged 3 to 5, with a low solid birch toddler bed and a birch book ledge
cards.scene: A bright airy room with wide pale oak floorboards and white skirting boards. On a rectangular flat-weave oat-and-sage wool rug lie three small carved wooden dinosaur figurines and an open hardcover picture book. On the RIGHT side wall, away from the mural: a low solid birch toddler bed 140 by 70 cm under 40 cm high neatly made with dusty blue washed linen bedding and two small sage-green and oat cotton pillows, a small solid oak bedside cube with a matte cream ceramic night light beside it, and a low birch book ledge holding three illustrated children's books. Warm morning sunbeams from a window on the RIGHT lie in soft patches across the oak floor and rug. Palette: dusty blue, pale birch, oat and warm white.
cards.framing: Shot from the left part of the room at natural eye level, turned about 25 degrees toward the mural wall, so the RIGHT side wall is in view. The frame shows a floor-to-ceiling section of the mural wall around the three watercolour dinosaurs in the centre: the ceiling line at the top of the frame, the skirting board and a strip of floor at the bottom; the mural continues beyond the frame edges at its true scale. Nothing stands in front of the mural and no curtain hangs in the frame.

cards.subject: a calm Japandi bedroom for a child aged 3 to 5, with a low solid oak toddler bed and a wooden toy bench
cards.scene: A bright airy room with wide warm oak floorboards and white skirting boards. On a round flat-weave cream cotton rug lie wooden building blocks and small carved wooden dinosaur toys. On the LEFT side wall, away from the mural: a low solid oak toddler bed 140 by 70 cm under 40 cm high neatly made with warm sand linen bedding and a dusty blue cotton cushion, and a low wooden toy bench beside it holding two stacked wooden puzzle boxes. Soft afternoon window light from the LEFT casts gentle natural shadows across the oak floor and rug. A small boy of about four in a navy knit sweater and light grey trousers sits on the rug in the middle of the floor about two metres from the mural wall, facing the mural with his back to the camera, his face turned away from the camera so no facial detail is visible, arranging the small wooden dinosaur toys on the rug. Palette: pale oak, cream, muted sage and dusty slate blue.
cards.framing: Shot from the right part of the room at eye level, turned about 25 degrees toward the mural wall, so the LEFT side wall is in view. The frame shows a floor-to-ceiling section of the mural wall around the three watercolour dinosaurs in the centre: the ceiling line at the top of the frame, the skirting board and a strip of floor at the bottom; the mural continues beyond the frame edges at its true scale.

clips.motion: The camera does not move at all: it is a fixed, static shot. Fine dust drifts slowly through the sunbeam and the warm sunlight patches on the floor shift gently. The mural on the wall stays perfectly still and unchanged: its drawing, its colours and every painted animal remain exactly as in the first frame. The ceiling, the walls, the floor and the rug stay perfectly still.

clips.motion: The camera stays completely still on a tripod and does not move at all. A small boy of about four in a navy knit sweater and light grey trousers slowly arranges the small wooden dinosaur toys on the rug. His face is never visible to the camera, not even in profile: only the back of his head, his hair and his clothes are seen. He stays on the LEFT side of the frame, far from the three watercolour dinosaurs in the centre, and never passes in front of the mural. The soft light stays constant.
